Gymnastics

By: Tarryn Crossman | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

Unique Selling Point:
It’s been nearly a decade since Larry Nasser, physician to the USA Olympic gymnastics team was found guilty on multiple sexual assault cases, and Gymnastics federations around the world vowed it would never happen again. Globally new Safeguarding policies were put in place to protect the gymnasts, but are they enough.

We investigate how one coach allegedly physically, emotionally and sexually assaulted gymnasts for over a decade, and no-one took the time to believe the victims and investigate allegation of misconduct.

SAGF does an extensive 2 year investigation into how these allegations of assault were mishandled at a gymnastics club in the Free state, in the end all the gate keepers that ignored numerous red flags are still in positions of power, so how are the gymnasts of today any safer that the girls assault in 2010







Summary:
Derek Bezuidenhout was a gymnastics coach at his in-laws’ gymnastics club, Helena Botha. His wife, Leandre, is also a coach and international judge representing South Africa at international comps assigned by the SAGF. She and her mother, Liza-Mari Grous, are two of only 13 international judges in South Africa.

Derek, allegedly physical, sexually and emotionally abused multiple gymnasts at Helena Botha between 2009 – 2023, when he committed suicide.

Red flags about Dereks conduct started in 2013, but no-one believed the child.
No-one investigated further, instead they said it was hear say and moved on.
Again in 2016, more red flags were brought to the attention of the federation, again nothing was done.
Members of the executive committee for free state gymnastics are quoted as saying "Helena Botha's is a big club, this will not be good for Free State gymnastics, so we must just think carefully"

This is a timeline of the events of the case.


2009 – Helena Both has an overnight camp. Louis is a young gymnast (13-14 years old) scared to be away from home, so Derek offers to sleep beside her. He forces her to hold his penis in her hand the whole night.
In the years that follow, he spots her inappropriately, sticking his fingers in her vagina.
Various allegations

2010 – They go to a gymnastics dinner together. Dereks says he needs to go home to fetch his smokes before he drops her off. She blacks out and wakes up when she is in the bathroom and bleeding.
She tells her friend.

2011 – Shirley Frost starts as a coach @ Helena Botha
2011 – Louis quits gymnastics

2013 – Derek physically assaults Makaila Shirley’s daughter
Shirley tells Club owners about Louis’s assault

2013 – Derek goes to Louis’s house and tells her to send a message to the club owners and his wife saying ‘nothing happened’ She does that
Liza-Marie – the club owner, replies
‘I just want to protect you and Derek.”
Nothing is done.

2014 – Shirley again speaks out about Derek, rumours of how he was spotting the girls by putting his fingers in their vaginas
Shirley leaves the club.

2016 – SA Nationals
This photo is taken of Derek and a young girl who travelled alone to CT.
They stay at a separate location from his wife.

AJ Landman (judge from Helena Both) reports this conduct to Jannie Van Vuuren, Free State gymnastics exec committee.
He says he will handle it
Nothing is done

AJ Landman – speaks to Jannie on multiple occasions concerned with Derek’s conduct
Aggressive
Inappropriate contact with the girls
Ask his daughter for her number
He smacks his youngest child

2016 – Anon gymnast starts at Helena Botha – affidavit and her father anonymously
Derek comments on her breasts and spots her inappropriately.

2017 – affidavit and her father
A group of female gymnasts, including Anon, organise a party. They are 14 years old. Derek arrives and starts partying with them. He takes ultraviolet paint and paints on one of the girls’ breasts, telling her how he wants to touch her private parts

2017 – affidavit
Derek insists that anon sits up front with him en route to a gymnastics camp.
He asks her if she spits or swallows.

2017 – Annon opens a case of sexual harassment or assault – waiting for the case file
Reports incident to SAGF – gets no reply
Informs Free State gymnastics – nothing is done

2018 – SAFEGUARDING IN GYMNASTICS IS LAUNCHED
Johandri is the safety officer for Free State.
Shirley tells him to investigate the 2011 case—she doesn’t give him Louis’s name, so he does nothing.
He was told about the case that Anon opened, but they decided to leave it in the hands of the police and SAGF.
No action is taken against Derek.
He admits to chatting with Derek, as Derek is his longtime friend.

2022 – 2023 De Schmidt’s join Helena Both. Derek is their kid’s coach
Derek grooms them in the same way
Comes for braais with the family
The kids were at boarding school, so Derek offered to fetch them for gymnastics and return them to school.
Oldest daughter spends the night at Derek and his wife’s house
Derek turns after that and starts bullying her
Kicks her off the team a few times
Love bombs her, then punishes her
They confront the club and Free State Gymnastics
Nothing is done
They are asked to leave the club, as their daughter is a bully

2022 – Glen Joselowitz – a gymnastics assault survivor, is contacted by some of the girls abused by Derek
He does some investigating and puts the information together – information which Free State and SAGF all already had access to – he gives it to Hayley Walker their independent safety officer, and insists they investigate

2022 – 2023 – SAGF investigate Derek
Derek commits suicide
SAGF released their report and demanded an apology

Apologies attached – insulting to victims.

Everybody who ignores all the allegations against Derek goes back to working with children.

VO An elite high-performance sport requiring technical precision, discipline and dedication.

VO Gymnasts train for hours in pursuit of their dreams… to reach the highest level of the sport, they rely on equally dedicated coaches.

VO It's a close and complex relationship… a relationship sometimes plagued by abuse.

FADE TO BLACK

IDEA - lOURENSA WALKS INTO FRAME
This investigation uncovered shocking evidence of abuse by one coach, at one club.

He burnt my feet with a light.

But as the story unfolded it raised disturbing questions about how a system created to protect these girls, failed to identify abuse, never mind intervene

Soft slow cut
Establish the scene of them looking at photos
Louis with pigtails
LOUIS
I am in Grade 1 here.
These are our Free State colors

Photo scene
VO For much of her youth, Louis Eloff trained at the Helena Botha Gymnastics Club in Bloemfontein,
Her coach was this man, Derek Bezuidenhout.

Photos
LOUIS
Derek is the judge here.
Here, I was about 11 years old.
It was also a trampoline competition.

DEREK UPSOUND - YOU NEED TO JUMP HIGHER
COVER WITH DEREK VISUALS 8MM LOOK,
SEQUENCE 1
VO Derek was a revered Trampoline in the Free State.
He dated and would later marry the daughter of Helena Botha's owner, Kenny Gous,
KENNY
1. He was the most qualified coach for trampoline in the Free State and the country.
2. He was brilliant. He won the most gold medals at the SA champs out of all the clubs.

VISUALS OF DEREK
VO He may have been a brilliant coach, but FOR OVER A DECADE, there were multiple rumours about alleged inappropriate conduct involving young female gymnasts.

LOUIS
He called me Jellytots because I didn’t have breasts.
And when I got breasts, he teased me because of my larger breast size.


Sit up scene
VO Louis says Derek first sexually assaulted her at an overnight winter camp in 2010.

1. I was very scared to sleep out, and Derek said that he would sleep next to me.
2. I literally trusted Derek with my life. I had known him for a long time; he was my coach and had a good relationship with my mother.
3. All I remember is that we were asleep, and he woke me up, and I had to sleep the whole night with his thing in my hand.
4. I kept asking what the time was,
5. because I just wanted it to end.
6.
Awkward hand shop
VO The only person Louis told about what Derek was doing was a fellow gymnast.

LOUIS
He was almost like a father figure. I convinced myself that he had just made a mistake.

ARCHIVE OF DEREK COACHING
VO Derek continued coaching… Louis's trauma only ever a hushed whisper within the walls of the Helena Botha gymnastics club.

2” ON DERERK

HERO GLEN INTRO
VO BUT Then, In 2021 former gymnast, sexual abuse survivor, and activist, Glen Joslewitz was asked to investigate Derek.


GLENN
I had three victims who contacted me. They gave me names of other victims, but They didn't want to talk to me.
The one victim, Louise, was adamant she wouldn't talk to me.
, and I promised her that I'd be by her side.

LOUIS PHOTOS
VO For the first time, Louis felt someone believed her, so she agreed to tell her story. She told Glenn that, 10 years before, a few months after the first assault Derek raped her

LOUIS
All I remember is that I was sitting on the toilet, and I was bleeding, and there was a little pot of Vaseline next to the basin.

I didn’t immediately know what happened until I found out that when you lose your virginity, you do bleed.

LOUIS PHOTOS OF GYMNASTICS
VO Desperate to feel safe, Louis quit gymnastics after that year's national champs

Lourensa - what would you say to that girl today
Louis - ….. Hold on ….
Phone visuals
VO But two years later, louis claims Derek showed up at her house, demanding that she send a message to the owners of Helena Botha saying nothing happened

LOUIS
He told me to send a message, or he will kill himself.
Something must have happened.
Why else would he want to silence me?
Something must have come out.

RE-ENACTMENT
VO According to multiple sources,, it was at this point in 2013 that the owners of Helena Botha were informed that Derek had allegedly assaulted louis.

Kenny
That is completely untrue
So none of you knew about what Derek was doing to Louis
No

LOURENSA INVESTIGATING
VO During our investigation we contacted coaches and judges from Helena Botha to find out if anyone had seen or heard anything over the years.

lOURENSA ON THE PHONE
I know this is difficult, but we will keep you anonymous.

VO This gymnast was allegedly physically assaulted - some would say tortured - by Derek in 2014

1;29 He made me very scared to be on the trampoline.
1:31 - when I tried to quit derek burnt my feet with a lighter
Lourensa - Did you ever discuss this with anyone else?
1:44 - yes the club did know about it it was done in front of a lot of people

VO AJ landman was a judge for Helena Botha, He sent us this photo of Derek, then in his early thirties, and a 14-year-old gymnast at national champs in 2016.

AJ- He arrived at the restaurant with the girl and she was still in her Pj’s
You could see there was something going on
LOURENSA - So she accompanied Derrick alone to this competition.
AJ - YES
LOURENSA - Did you tell this anyone at Free State gymnastics
AJ - I reported to
I spoke to Jannie about it

VO AJ says he reported Derek to Jannie Janse Van Vuuren, the president of Southern Free State Gymnastics.

Jannie said I am not happy with what he is doing, but if I go after Derek, what will happen to the free state.

We spoke to a father, and he said he raised concerns about
Jannie
I remember AJ was at my house when we talked about that, and it was not a race concern. It was more of a conversation

DOCS GRAPHICS
VO In 2017, Derek allegedly assaulted another 14-year-old gymnast, who we'll keep anonymous.

VO She wrote this damning affidavit detailing what Derek had done to her.

VO Much like he did with Louis, he would comment on her breasts or try to start conversations about sex.

VO From there, things escalated, as Derek allegedly started touching her private parts during training - exactly what Louis had claimed.

RE-ENACTMENT
VO This alleged victim laid a charge, but a lack of evidence meant it never made it to court.
She also reported her case to the SA Gymnastics Federation, the sport's governing bod, as well as Free State Gymnastics, but neither federation took action - something we confronted Jannie about.

LOURENSA - You found out about this case of severe sexual abuse. Did you not think to suspend him from that position
JANNIE - We had Derek come into our meetings to discuss this with him. And he also told us that there was a case but that it had been dismissed.
LOURENSA - you decide to talk to Derek about this?
J- Yes..
LOURENSA - He comes in and says, I didn't do it. Do you accept that?
JANNIE - Looking back now, what might have been wrong, but as I said, there was never a case against him.

SAGF ALSO FOUND THAT WITHOUT A POLICE CASE THERE WAS NOT ENOUGH TO INVESTIGATE

GLENN
You're not going to get evidence of sexual assault. It's not done in public. You will catch them in the reporting. You will see them when rumours come out. If there's sexual assault, it's too late. AND There are probably going to be multiple victims. And the system has already failed.

Push up scene
Vo With allegations dating back to 2011, Glenn now demanded that the SAGF conduct an extensive investigation into Derek, the club, Free State Gymnastics, and the federation.

GLENN
Undoubtedly, if someone had listened to any of those numerous flags back then, they certainly would have stopped it.

RE-ENACTMENT - FIST DEREK COACHING
Vo During the Gymnastic Federation's investigation, Derek allegedly tried to silence Louis again.

LOUIS
1. they called my dad back and requested that he speak to me so that I could just let everything go.

Derek coaching
Vo This time, Louis refused… and it's here that Derek Bezuidenhout's story takes an unexpected turn: with Glenn maintaining pressure, and the Federation looking at the evidence, Derek took his own life in January 2023

Hold on derek coaching

1. You claim that Derek did not find peace What do you think his reason was to commit suicide?
2. To protect his family.
3. From what?
4. From the attack on the club by certain parties.

W of donny
VO In April this year the Gymnastics Federation delivered its final report on the investigation. Donny Jurgen was the president at the time of this interview

DONNY - The findings were that people didn't respond to this in the Free State adequately.
DONNY - They didn't follow our procedures. they didn't listen to the victims and take the case as seriously as we would want to
Lourensa - Did you have no responsibility for protecting those girls? No I am not saying that
You are the president of CGF. Yes. And stops with you. Does it not? Yet it does stop with me as president.
DONNY - It's difficult to get down to the level of each and every club, each and every school. Besides the 300 clubs, we have 428 schools. it's a mammoth task. we are doing as much as we can with very limited resources.


Helena both gyma
VO As a result of the findings, the Federation suspended Helena Botha, or Central Infinity as the club is now known, until a letter of apology was sent to the victims.

KENNY
I said sorry for whatever we could have done wrong.
Lourensa - But why apologize if you think you did nothing wrong and it is all just a smear campaign against you and Derek?
Why would you say sorry, and what are you sorry for.
KENNY - Because as soon as we wrote a letter, the suspension was lifted.

Letter graphics
VO After this apology letter was sent, the club reopened, and it was business as usual.

Jannies Broll
VO A warning letter was issued to Free State Gymnastics, but no-one was suspended or dismissed, including Jannie Janse Van Vuuren who remains president of southern freestate

JANNIE
You failed to protect these girls. If you had acted earlier, they might not have been so many victims. Yes, we know about two victims. And we lost gymnasts to them because it was one of the best trampoline coaches in Free State.


LOUIS
Do you believe that the system will ultimately fail other girls as well?
Absolutely. If the same people stay. If the same people are on the panel, if the same people are participating in the Free State, if the very same people are in the SAGF, why would anything change now?

FINAL SHOT RE-ENACTMENT

Last shot – W shot of girl in the blue leotard, and she stop and looks down

metadata.Unique Selling Point: It’s been nearly a decade since Larry Nasser, physician to the USA Olympic gymnastics team was found guilty on multiple sexual assault cases, and Gymnastics federations around the world vowed it would never happen again. Globally new Safeguarding policies were put in place to protect the gymnasts, but are they enough. We investigate how one coach allegedly physically, emotionally and sexually assaulted gymnasts for over a decade, and no-one took the time to believe the victims and investigate allegation of misconduct. SAGF does an extensive 2 year investigation into how these allegations of assault were mishandled at a gymnastics club in the Free state, in the end all the gate keepers that ignored numerous red flags are still in positions of power, so how are the gymnasts of today any safer that the girls assault in 2010
metadata.Summary: Derek Bezuidenhout was a gymnastics coach at his in-laws’ gymnastics club, Helena Botha. His wife, Leandre, is also a coach and international judge representing South Africa at international comps assigned by the SAGF. She and her mother, Liza-Mari Grous, are two of only 13 international judges in South Africa. Derek, allegedly physical, sexually and emotionally abused multiple gymnasts at Helena Botha between 2009 – 2023, when he committed suicide. Red flags about Dereks conduct started in 2013, but no-one believed the child. No-one investigated further, instead they said it was hear say and moved on. Again in 2016, more red flags were brought to the attention of the federation, again nothing was done. Members of the executive committee for free state gymnastics are quoted as saying "Helena Botha's is a big club, this will not be good for Free State gymnastics, so we must just think carefully" This is a timeline of the events of the case. 2009 – Helena Both has an overnight camp. Louis is a young gymnast (13-14 years old) scared to be away from home, so Derek offers to sleep beside her. He forces her to hold his penis in her hand the whole night. In the years that follow, he spots her inappropriately, sticking his fingers in her vagina. Various allegations 2010 – They go to a gymnastics dinner together. Dereks says he needs to go home to fetch his smokes before he drops her off. She blacks out and wakes up when she is in the bathroom and bleeding. She tells her friend. 2011 – Shirley Frost starts as a coach @ Helena Botha 2011 – Louis quits gymnastics 2013 – Derek physically assaults Makaila Shirley’s daughter Shirley tells Club owners about Louis’s assault 2013 – Derek goes to Louis’s house and tells her to send a message to the club owners and his wife saying ‘nothing happened’ She does that Liza-Marie – the club owner, replies ‘I just want to protect you and Derek.” Nothing is done. 2014 – Shirley again speaks out about Derek, rumours of how he was spotting the girls by putting his fingers in their vaginas Shirley leaves the club. 2016 – SA Nationals This photo is taken of Derek and a young girl who travelled alone to CT. They stay at a separate location from his wife. AJ Landman (judge from Helena Both) reports this conduct to Jannie Van Vuuren, Free State gymnastics exec committee. He says he will handle it Nothing is done AJ Landman – speaks to Jannie on multiple occasions concerned with Derek’s conduct Aggressive Inappropriate contact with the girls Ask his daughter for her number He smacks his youngest child 2016 – Anon gymnast starts at Helena Botha – affidavit and her father anonymously Derek comments on her breasts and spots her inappropriately. 2017 – affidavit and her father A group of female gymnasts, including Anon, organise a party. They are 14 years old. Derek arrives and starts partying with them. He takes ultraviolet paint and paints on one of the girls’ breasts, telling her how he wants to touch her private parts 2017 – affidavit Derek insists that anon sits up front with him en route to a gymnastics camp. He asks her if she spits or swallows. 2017 – Annon opens a case of sexual harassment or assault – waiting for the case file Reports incident to SAGF – gets no reply Informs Free State gymnastics – nothing is done 2018 – SAFEGUARDING IN GYMNASTICS IS LAUNCHED Johandri is the safety officer for Free State. Shirley tells him to investigate the 2011 case—she doesn’t give him Louis’s name, so he does nothing. He was told about the case that Anon opened, but they decided to leave it in the hands of the police and SAGF. No action is taken against Derek. He admits to chatting with Derek, as Derek is his longtime friend. 2022 – 2023 De Schmidt’s join Helena Both. Derek is their kid’s coach Derek grooms them in the same way Comes for braais with the family The kids were at boarding school, so Derek offered to fetch them for gymnastics and return them to school. Oldest daughter spends the night at Derek and his wife’s house Derek turns after that and starts bullying her Kicks her off the team a few times Love bombs her, then punishes her They confront the club and Free State Gymnastics Nothing is done They are asked to leave the club, as their daughter is a bully 2022 – Glen Joselowitz – a gymnastics assault survivor, is contacted by some of the girls abused by Derek He does some investigating and puts the information together – information which Free State and SAGF all already had access to – he gives it to Hayley Walker their independent safety officer, and insists they investigate 2022 – 2023 – SAGF investigate Derek Derek commits suicide SAGF released their report and demanded an apology Apologies attached – insulting to victims. Everybody who ignores all the allegations against Derek goes back to working with children.
